tagline: Kyama. Ku bwereere. Mu lulimi lwo.
heroSub: Funa amawulire agukwata ku muntu — mu kyama, mu lulimi lwo.
step1Desc: Ebibuuzo ebyangu ku bulamu n'ebyo gy'oyagala.
step2Desc: Tulondoola okusinziira ku biragiro bya WHO.
card1Desc: Oli omupya? Tujja kukuyamba okunoonya enkola entuufu.
card2Desc: Omaze okukozesa enkola? Funa obuyambi obwangu.
privacyBanner: ContraBot tatereka mannya go oba nnamba yo. Okwogera kwo kya kyama.
emptyFacilities: Tetulabye bifo mu kitundu kino. Gezaako ekibuga ekikumpi.
